name: GPU Compute Programmer
description: Write GPU kernels and compute shaders using CUDA, OpenCL, or Vulkan Compute. Optimize memory coalescing, occupancy, and parallel algorithms.
example_snippet:
program GPUStub:
    # Dictum transpiles to C++, then nvcc compiles CUDA
    shape GPUBuffer holds:
        DevicePtr as raw handle to byte
        Size as count

        method allocate takes Bytes as count produces result:
            # Would call cudaMalloc
            print the text "Allocating " and Bytes and " bytes on GPU" and newline
            produce success with nothing
        end method
    end shape

    keep Buf as GPUBuffer
    call Buf.allocate with 1048576
    print the text "GPU buffer ready" and newline
end program
